MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

2. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 21
   C. 30
   D. 42

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 66
   C. 17
   D. 34

5. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19.6

6. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 37
   D. 1

7. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

10. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 6
   C. 36
   D. 7

11. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 2

12. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
